018package org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc;
019
020import static org.apiguardian.api.API.Status.STABLE;
021import static org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.ToolKit.EMPTY_STRING;
022
023import org.apiguardian.api.API;
024import org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.SimpleTagletBase;
025import org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.foundation.annotation.ClassVersion;
026
027/**
028 *  <p>{@summary The contents of this inline tag will be ignored for the
029 *  generation of the Javadoc output.} Different from the
030 *  &quot;<code>&#64;hidden</code>&quot; tag that excludes the whole comment
031 *  block from the generated documentation, this tag will just exclude the part
032 *  within the brackets.</p>
033 *  <p>So for example, the sequence &quot;<i><code>{&#64;{@value %s #TAGLET_NAME}
034 *  This text will not appear in the documentation}</code></i>&quot; would just not
035 *  show up. This can be used to add a raw, human-readable description to the
036 *  documentation for something that needs to be prepared in some special way
037 *  for the documentation output that makes it nearly unreadable in the source
038 *  code.</p>
039 *
040 *  @author Thomas Thrien - thomas.thrien@tquadrat.org
041 *  @version $Id: IgnoreTaglet.java 1282 2026-09-08 23:52:53Z tquadrat $
042 *  @since 0.0.5
043 */
044@ClassVersion( sourceVersion = "$Id: IgnoreTaglet.java 1282 2026-09-08 23:52:53Z tquadrat $" )
045@API( status = STABLE, since = "0.0.5" )
046public final class IgnoreTaglet extends SimpleTagletBase
047{
048        /*-----------*\
049    ====** Constants **========================================================
050        \*-----------*/
051    /**
052     *  <p>{@summary The name of this taglet: {@value}.}</p>
053     */
054    public static final String TAGLET_NAME = "ignore";
055
056        /*--------------*\
057    ====** Constructors **=====================================================
058        \*--------------*/
059    /**
060     *  <p>{@summary Creates a new {@code IgnoreTaglet} instance.}</p>
061     */
062    public IgnoreTaglet()
063    {
064        super( TAGLET_NAME, EMPTY_STRING );
065    }   //  IgnoreTaglet()
066}
067//  class IgnoreTaglet
068
069/*
070 *  End of File
071 */
